ceo.name: Martina L. Cheung
ceo.background: Joined S&P Global in 2010 as VP of Operations for Ratings. Rose through Chief Strategy Officer, President of Market Intelligence (2019-2022), President of Ratings (2022-2024). Prior: Partner at Mitchell Madison Consulting; Accenture Financial Services Strategy. Education: BA Commerce + MA Business Studies, National University of Ireland Galway.
ceo.track_record: Led Ratings to $3.3B revenue in 2023 (+9% YoY, 56.5% operating margin). Drove Sustainable1 revenue growth 24% in 2023. Instrumental in IHS Markit merger (2022, ~$44B) and SNL Financial acquisition (2015). Under her CEO tenure, FY2024 revenue $14.2B (+14% YoY), GAAP net income $3.85B (+47% YoY), GAAP diluted EPS $12.35 (+50% YoY), returned >$4.4B to shareholders. Named Barron's 100 Most Influential Women in U.S. Finance (2025), American Banker Most Powerful Women in Finance (2024).
ceo.predecessor: Douglas L. Peterson (CEO 2013-2024, remained advisor through Dec 2025)

cfo.name: Eric W. Aboaf
cfo.background: CFO and Vice Chairman at State Street Corporation for ~8 years (2016-2025). Prior: CFO of Citizens Financial Group; 12 years at Citigroup including Treasurer managing $1.9T balance sheet; Partner at Bain & Company co-leading US financial services consulting. Education: Wharton (summa cum laude), MS from MIT.
cfo.scope: Oversees finance, strategy, M&A, ventures, and corporate responsibility disclosures.
